entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: White-aligned god of battle from Kaldheim, protector of the Skoti.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane where Halvar is a god.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: People Halvar considers himself protector of; fought the Einir.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God who adopted Halvar as his son.

entities.name: Axgard
entities.description: Place where Alrund found the orphaned baby.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The then reigning gods defeated by the Skoti.

entities.name: Galdrimel
entities.description: Dwarf-crafted axe able to sever any substance, even the Cosmos.

entities.name: Cosmos
entities.description: The substance of the cosmos that Galdrimel and the Sword of the Realms can cut.

entities.name: Koll
entities.description: Dwarf about to give Halvar the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Legendary blade capable of cutting through the Cosmos, stolen by Tibalt and later given to Halvar.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who stole the Sword of the Realms and caused the Doomskar.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Event caused by Tibalt in which Halvar defended a bridge.

entities.name: Dread Marn
entities.description: Zombies from Karfell fought by Halvar.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who handed Halvar the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: Asked to protect the bridge with Kaya.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm where the invading remnants were trapped.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Cracks Halvar closed to end the Doomskar.

events.summary: Alrund adopts an orphaned baby found in an eagle's nest and names him Halvar, leaving him as the dwarf king's ward for twenty years.
events.quote: Alrund adopted the baby as his son and named him Halvar

events.summary: Halvar wields Galdrimel against the Einir and splits the elf race into wood elves and shadow elves.
events.quote: Halvar used it to split the elf race in half

events.summary: Tibalt steals the Sword of the Realms before Koll can give it to Halvar.
events.quote: before it was stolen by the planeswalker Tibalt

events.summary: Halvar defends a bridge to a Bretagard village against the Dread Marn during the Doomskar.
events.quote: Halvar defended a bridge that leads to a Bretagard village

events.summary: Kaya hands Halvar the Sword of the Realms and he closes the Omenpaths, ending the Doomskar.
events.quote: By focusing Halvar managed to close all the cracks and end Tibalt's Doomskar

relations.quote: Alrund adopted the baby as his son and named him Halvar
During the Doomskar that Tibalt had caused

relations.note: Gave him the Sword of the Realms.
